Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct, zlib, pathlib

def chunk(t, d):
    return struct.pack('>I', len(d)) + t + d + struct.pack('>I', zlib.crc32(t+d)&0xffffffff)

sig=b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'
ihdr=chunk(b'IHDR', struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',1,1,8,6,0,0,0))
# huge ancillary length with no payload? invalid file, but maybe parser reads and crashes? need exact bytes.
# create tEXt length 0x7fffffff impossible file size, not useful.
# Instead create malformed chunk length 0 causing edge cases.
text0=struct.pack('>I',0)+b'tEXt'+b''+struct.pack('>I', zlib.crc32(b'tEXt')&0xffffffff)
idat=chunk(b'IDAT', zlib.compress(b'\x00\x00\x00\x00'))
iend=chunk(b'IEND', b'')
for name,data in [('z1.png', sig+ihdr+text0+idat+iend), ('z2.png', sig+ihdr+idat+text0+iend), ('z3.png', sig+ihdr+idat+iend+text0)]:
    pathlib.Path(name).write_bytes(data)
    print(name, len(data))
